assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and all three KEY_AREA polygons are repository provisional rough geometry, not official planning boundaries.
assumptions.impact: All precision-sensitive geometry, metrics, figures, and drawings require full recalculation after official polygons are available.

assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, density, road redlines, setbacks, ownership, heritage controls, utilities, fire, and engineering conditions are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Building, land-use, mobility, and infrastructure moves are conceptual references only.

assumptions.statement: Every AI public-service pilot exposes purpose, minimum data, accountable operator, human fallback, stop condition, and review date.
assumptions.impact: The proposal prioritizes public accountability over maximum automation.

assumptions.statement: International innovation-district cases are mechanism comparisons, not site-equivalent evidence.
assumptions.impact: Current official sources and local applicability require verification before professional use.
